name: Guided Passage Study
description: Seven steps, with one free-text answer per step.

sections.title: People
sections.guidance: Who speaks, acts or receives the message? Distinguish what the text says from your assumptions.

sections.title: Place
sections.guidance: Which places and relationships matter to this passage?

sections.title: Time
sections.guidance: When does this happen? Mark uncertain historical proposals as uncertain.

sections.title: Flow of the Passage
sections.guidance: Follow the events, structure, reasoning and movement of the passage. This also applies to letters, poetry and arguments.

sections.title: Theme
sections.guidance: What is the passage about, and what does it say about that subject?

sections.title: Understanding
sections.guidance: Explain the meaning in context. Distinguish observations, interpretation and questions still open.

sections.title: Consequences
sections.guidance: What follows for faith, love and life? Let application follow the meaning of the passage.
